scene.label: Act 3, Scene 5
scene.title: SCENE V. Without the walls of Florence.

content.text: Enter an old Widow of Florence, Diana, Violenta, Mariana and other Citizens.

lines.text: Nay, come; for if they do approach the city, we shall lose all the sight.
lines.plainText: Nay come for if they do approach the city we shall lose all the sight

lines.text: They say the French count has done most honourable service.
lines.plainText: They say the French count has done most honourable service

lines.text: It is reported that he has taken their great'st commander, and that with his own hand he slew the duke's brother.
lines.plainText: It is reported that he has taken their great'st commander and that with his own hand he slew the duke's brother

lines.text: Come, let's return again, and suffice ourselves with the report of it. Well, Diana, take heed of this French earl; the honour of a maid is her name; and no legacy is so rich as honesty.
lines.plainText: Come let's return again and suffice ourselves with the report of it Well Diana take heed of this French earl the honour of a maid is her name and no legacy is so rich as honesty

lines.text: I have told my neighbour how you have been solicited by a gentleman his companion.
lines.plainText: I have told my neighbour how you have been solicited by a gentleman his companion

lines.text: I know that knave; hang him! one Parolles; a filthy officer he is in those suggestions for the young earl. Beware of them, Diana; their promises, enticements, oaths, tokens, and all these engines of lust, are not the things they go under; many a maid hath been seduced by them; and the misery is, example, that so terrible shows in the wreck of maidenhood, cannot for all that dissuade succession, but that they are limed with the twigs that threaten them. I hope I need not to advise you further; but I hope your own grace will keep you where you are, though there were no further danger known but the modesty which is so lost.

content.text: Enter Helena in the dress of a pilgrim.

lines.text: I hope so. Look, here comes a pilgrim. I know she will lie at my house; thither they send one another; I'll question her. God save you, pilgrim! Whither are bound?
